title: Offline Speech Transcription Pipeline
description: Build an audio-processing pipeline that ingests recordings, computes mel-spectrogram features, runs speech transcription, and produces per-segment, timestamped transcripts evaluated with Word Error Rate on a fixed public evaluation set.
learningObjectives: Load, resample, and normalize audio deterministically
Run ASR inference and align outputs to time segments
Measure Word Error Rate on a fixed evaluation set

milestones.title: Deterministic audio ingestion
milestones.objective: Implement resampling, duration checks, and normalization; unit-test determinism on fixtures.

milestones.title: Mel-spectrogram features
milestones.objective: Compute mel features and visualize them for two example clips.
milestones.expectedOutput: Feature module + rendered spectrograms in the report.

milestones.title: Transcription stage
milestones.objective: Run an offline/open ASR model over the clips, producing segments with timestamps.

milestones.title: WER evaluation
milestones.objective: Score transcripts against a fixed reference set; record overall WER plus the worst clips.

categories.minimumExpectation: Pipeline runs end-to-end on fixed clips
categories.excellentExpectation: Edge cases (empty audio, silence-only) handled with tests

categories.minimumExpectation: WER on a stated evaluation set

categories.excellentExpectation: CI smoke test on a tiny fixture clip

architecture: Reports read only from artifact files
constraints: No cloud-only runtime dependency; document any gated model checkpoint source
hints: Write WER scoring yourself on a reference set; it is a small deterministic function and a common interview topic
